versos.texto_bv: Tamar vestia uma túnica multicolorida, pois esse era o tipo de manto usado pelas filhas virgens do rei. O servo de Amnom a pôs para fora e trancou a porta atrás dela.
versos.traducao_literal: E sobre ela, túnica de faixas, pois assim vestiam as filhas do rei, as virgens, mantos; e fez sair a ela seu servidor para fora e trancou a porta atrás dela.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “túnica multicolorida” diverge de NTLH (“vestido longo, de mangas compridas”), ARA (“túnica talar”) e NVIPT (“túnica longa”), que descrevem comprimento, não cor. — evidência: O heb. ketonet passim (כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים) é interpretado pelas três referências como vestimenta longa/talar. A BV segue a tradição LXX (“variada/multicolorida”). A correção para “longa” exigiria mudança semântica/exegética, fora do escopo da revisão de forma.

kjv.texto: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king’s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

vizinhos.17: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.
vizinhos.19: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

web.texto: She had a garment of various colors on her; for with such robes were the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

vizinhos.17: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”
vizinhos.19: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head, and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
